observations.code_quote: | Persistence after stop | Everything stays on the user's machine.                                      | `devbox:stop` keeps the disk, including `/home`. Only `devbox:destroy` deletes it.                        | The sandbox is destroyed after an idle timeout: 30 minutes for background runs, 1 hour for user-created runs, 10 minutes for PostHog AI runs, and at most 2 hours with a per-task override. Interactive Modal runs snapshot `/tmp/workspace` before cleanup so a follow-up can restore it. Files outside `/tmp/workspace` are lost. |
